Bryan Guin Founder/CPO Bryan was previously a machine learning researcher at Cornell and a software engineer at Agentive (YC S23) where he built AI systems for auditors. He also led product consulting teams at EY, advising Fortune 500 clients on new product development and deployment. Company Launches Avallon – AI Agents for Insurance Claims Operations Insurance customer satisfaction is plummeting as manual processing creates endless delays. Avallon automates back-office claims work for carriers and TPAs with AI agents that handle calls, documents, and data entry so adjusters can resolve cases faster. Insurance adjusters are drowning in manual work to process claims. This creates delays, errors, and frustrated policyholders while burying adjusters in tedious work instead of decision-making. Adjusters face three major bottlenecks: Fragmented communication: Adjusters spend hours fielding routine calls and emails to gather and relay claim information. Phone tag with claimants, vendors, and internal teams creates delays and frustration. Slow document review: Sifting through unstructured documents, photos, and reports to validate evidence is time-intensive. Manual review of complex documentation slows case resolution. Tedious record keeping: Converting notes and decisions into structured data for claims management systems requires constant manual data entry. An aging workforce exacerbates these issues, creating a talent shortage as workloads grow. With median adjuster compensation already at $109k and razor-thin margins for carriers and TPAs, the economics of manual processing are unsustainable. Meet Avallon: Your Team of AI Claims Agents Avallon's AI agents plug directly into existing claims management systems and automate these tedious tasks, helping adjusters resolve cases more quickly. Our AI agents work autonomously to handle: Communication workflows: Our agents handle routine calls and emails, gathering claim information while eliminating phone tag and keeping all parties updated. Document analysis: Our AI instantly processes unstructured documents, photos, and reports, extracting key data points and validating coverage details in seconds. Data management: Our agents automatically convert all findings into structured data and populate your claims management system, eliminating manual data entry and errors. Avallon’s intelligent agents turn claims management from reactive to proactive, helping adjusters make faster decisions, reduce errors, and deliver exceptional customer experiences. Team: The team met as grad students at Cornell studying computer science and operations research. Cornelius had previously built the complete ops infrastructure to scale FINN US from 0 to $15M ARR as a founding engineer at the car subscription platform. There he saw firsthand how broken fleet claims processes are. Bryan previously led product teams consulting for Fortune 500s at EY and conducted ML research at Cornell. Jet studied quantitative trading algorithms, is a national champion policy debater, and taught debate at the Taipei American School. During a fall break hiking trip, the team brainstormed startup ideas until Avallon took shape. They shipped the first version around Christmas, landed their first customer weeks later, and dropped out to pursue the company full-time. Asks: We're excited to connect with: Insurance company executives and claims leaders who want faster, smarter claim resolutions. Industry advisors and operators passionate about digitizing and modernizing insurance processes. Journalists and thought leaders interested in highlighting innovation and transformation within the insurance industry. If you’re ready to streamline your claims operations with AI, email us at founders@avallon.ai or schedule a demo at avallon.ai.

evidence.title: How Athens Administrators automatically resolves 64% of inbound calls with Avallon - Avallon Success Story
evidence.excerpt: Calls handled per month Calls automatically resolved by AI agent Average CSAT score Challenge High call volume overwhelms adjusters and delays critical claim work Call volume at Athens, especially around pay cycles, was overwhelming reception lines and claims examiners. Injured workers and medical providers called repeatedly with routine questions about bill status and payout cycles, constantly interrupting adjusters throughout the day and pulling them away from complex claims work. Callers faced long wait times and after-hours voicemails, creating frustration on both sides. Athens needed a scalable solution that could handle routine inquiries accurately, comply with identity verification requirements, and seamlessly escalate relevant calls to human adjusters. Solution AI voice agents handle inbound calls 24/7 with real-time claims system integration Results Athens saves adjuster time while improving caller experience The results: - 2000+ calls handled per month, removing massive volume from adjusters' workload - 64% of calls fully resolved by AI without human intervention - 4.6/5 average CSAT score from callers Adjusters are no longer constantly interrupted and can focus on complex claims investigation and decision-making. Injured workers and medical providers get instant answers anytime—evenings, weekends, holidays—without waiting on hold. What's Next Athens and Avallon are expanding their partnership beyond inbound call automation. The next phase includes: - Outbound communications to medical providers: Proactively checking on treatment status and documentation requirements - Document intelligence: Implementing contextual analysis and summarization of relevant claim information to streamline adjuster workflows As Athens continues to scale its AI capabilities with Avallon, the company is positioned to deliver even greater operational efficiency while maintaining the high-touch service that has defined its reputation in the workers' compensation industry.

evidence.title: About - Avallon
evidence.excerpt: Claims operations have long been bogged down by outdated systems and repetitive tasks. Adjusters are overwhelmed with administrative work, and an aging workforce adds to the strain as claim volumes rise. Inefficiencies in claim intake, subrogation, dispute resolutions, and after-hours operations slow down processing and reduce service quality. Avallon offers a better solution. Our platform uses conversational AI and cutting edge machine learning to automate tedious tasks, seamlessly integrating with your systems. Whether you’re a carrier, MGA, or TPA, Avallon adapts to your workflows, boosting productivity and eliminating friction. With our scalable context engine, every interaction is infused with the right information, freeing your team to focus on strategic decisions and creative problem‑solving. Avallon empowers operators to manage millions of claims workflows more efficiently, accurately, and with uninterrupted service, even after hours. The future of claims operations is here, and Avallon is leading the way. Leadership Team Avallon is led by a team of operators and engineers with deep industry expertise and technical knowledge, formed at Cornell University through a shared background in computer science and operations research. Moritz was among the first hires for Taktile’s U.S. office, where he scaled operations in the U.S. market and worked with some of the world’s largest insurance companies and fintechs to deploy AI-based decisioning systems. He studied computer science and business at the Technical University of Munich and machine learning and optimization at MIT. Leander was a senior software engineer at FINN, where he built core systems for subscription lifecycle, retention, and billing across a fleet of over 60,000 vehicles. He previously worked on AI automation, fraud prevention, and operational tooling, and studied computer science and economics at Stuttgart Media University. Backed by the Best We're backed by top venture capital firms and investors.

Enterprise Integration: Custom setup for your specific systems. Frequently Asked Questions How will Avallon integrate with my systems? Our forward deployed engineering team will work closely with yours to seamlessly integrate Avallon with your existing systems, including claims management platforms, REST APIs, ERP software, email, and more. How much does Avallon cost annually? Avallon's pricing is tailored to meet your specific needs and adjusts according to the value we deliver. Our pricing takes into account factors such as: - The volume of claims processed - The complexity of system integrations - The specific features and functionalities you require This ensures you only pay for what you need, with pricing that grows with the impact Avallon delivers to your claims operations. Can the Avallon voice AI agent adapt to a wide variety of call scripts? Yes, the Avallon voice AI agent can be configured to handle multiple variations of claims call scripts. Our engineering team will assist in setting up each version to meet your organization’s needs. If I own a smaller claims management operation, will Avallon still be effective for me? Absolutely. Avallon is designed to add value to claims teams of all sizes, with pricing that scales to suit your organization’s needs. What kind of support does Avallon offer after implementation? Avallon offers 24/7 assistance for critical issues, regular updates, and proactive monitoring. We’re available for troubleshooting, training, and any adjustments needed as your business evolves.
